title: Exclude non-routable hierarchy items from router WIP capacity
description: Router planning currently counts every issue in the active workflow state toward router.limits.project_wip, including initiatives and epics that have no valid agent route. On the live Kanbus board this produces project_wip_limit with no active worker packages and blocks real leaf stories such as KBS-d9c9ee. Count only routable leaf packages (or equivalent active router runs) in Python and Rust. Add parity coverage proving active epics and invalid-route issues do not consume capacity, while active routable packages still do. Preserve configured WIP limits.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Already fixed on develop. Python _current_route_counts (python/src/kanbus/issue_router.py ~913-939) and Rust planning (rust/src/router.rs ~2368-2382) count only routable leaf packages with a valid route; epics, initiatives and invalid-route issues are excluded. Shared Gherkin parity in features/router/router_routing_and_planning.feature ('Only routable leaf packages consume project WIP', 'An active routable leaf package consumes project WIP') passes in Python on develop 604d7c43; the Rust cucumber run was green on develop 2026-10-15. Closing.

right_now_summary: Python and Rust now count only routable leaf packages toward router WIP, with parity tests passing.
